claimChecks.claim: Bladder compliance uses vesical pressure and one fixed numeric cutoff establishes upper-tract safety or danger
claimChecks.locator: ICS §3.4.6; McGuire original abstract; EAU neuro risk/classification sections
claimChecks.note: Denominator is change in detrusor pressure; historic pressure at leakage in myelodysplasia is not sustained storage pressure or universal safe/unsafe boundary.

claimChecks.claim: True diverticula lack muscle and acquired obstruction later produces true diverticula
claimChecks.locator: Garat pathologic-results abstract; intradiverticular tumour review abstract
claimChecks.note: Congenital primary lesions can contain thin muscle; acquired pseudodiverticula have deficient muscle; no all-lesion rule inferred.

claimChecks.note: Ta is noninvasive, T1 reaches lamina propria, T2 reaches muscle; staging citation repaired.
